children: Interchain Foundation (ICF) said the recent Cosmos EVM incident affected some teams that rely on Cosmos technology for deployment, and it will establish a discretionary grant program to support impacted chains involved in remediation work. According to Odaily, ICF will also work with the community to invest resources in improving security practices, infrastructure, and incident response across the Cosmos ecosystem. Details of the grant program will be announced in the coming days.

title: Interchain Foundation to Set Up Discretionary Grant Program After Cosmos EVM Incident
